newsitem.title: USA: Shiva Corp target of another class action.
newsitem.headline: Shiva Corp target of another class action.

text.p: A second class action lawsuit has been filed against Shiva Corp accusing the networking equipment company of actions that inflated its stock price, plaintiff's attorneys said Thursday.
No one at Shiva was immediately available for comment Thursday evening.

A group of attorneys from Milberg Weiss Bershad Hynes & Lerach LLP, Bernard Gross, Schubert & Reed LLP and the offices of Jeffrey Abraham said the suit covers purchasers of Shiva stock from September 10, 1996 through March 31, 1997.
It was filed in U.S. District Court for the District of Massachusetts.
Shiva, based in Massachusetts, also was targeted in a class action suit May 22.

The newest complaint charges Shiva and certain of its officers and directors of misrepresenting information about the company's products and of presenting misleading financial statements, a statement from the attorneys said.
